art_direction: 钉崎以棕色短发与自然笑意入画，桃粉图形背景、米色外套和淡月轮构成利落半身像。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Create a graphic color-block portrait of Nobara Kugisaki with her straight auburn bob, clear cheek shape, and assured teenage presence. Dress her in a modest cream jacket over a plain dark top. One hand lightly holds the jacket lapel, while the other stays out of frame. Keep her chin level and her small smile genuine rather than smug. Build the background from two peach and dusty rose shapes, allowing the hair to stand apart from them. Use broad clean planes with only a few shadow divisions on the face and neck, avoiding elaborate cosmetic styling. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
